routes.label: Find one tenth of the votes

question:
Alicia, Brenda, and Colby were the candidates in a recent election for student president. The pie chart below shows how the votes were distributed among the three candidates. If Brenda received \(36\) votes, then how many votes were cast all together?

[Figure 1](figures/2017_AMC_8_Q02_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
The pie chart labels Brenda's share as \(30\%\), which is \(3/10\) of all the votes. Her \(36\) votes therefore make up three equal tenths. One tenth is \(36\div3=12\) votes, so all ten tenths contain
\[
12\times10=\boxed{120}
\]
votes. The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
